integrity: Proof self-contained; standalone exact combinatorial/Fourier checks and separate linear-programming midpoint checks included. Numerical checks are not substitutes for the all-n proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the one-hot embedded all-ones single ternary parity-check code and the unweighted one-skeleton Laplacian.
Published complete facet descriptions and earlier ternary embeddings are explicitly acknowledged.

title: Fourier spectrum and sharp connectivity of the ternary single-check codeword polytope
